prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Phoenix for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universal “best” personal-injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your accident and what you value (trial experience, maximum settlement record, communication style, fee structure, etc.). I can help you find a good match. Quick questions first:

- When did the accident happen? (Arizona’s general personal-injury statute of limitations is two years from the injury or discovery, A.R.S. § 12-542.)
- Were there serious injuries, fatalities, or complex liability issues (drunk driver, uninsured motorist, multiple vehicles)?
- Do you want a lawyer who takes cases to trial if needed, or one who usually settles?
- Any language, mobility, or scheduling needs?

How to find and evaluate the best lawyer for your case
- Search trusted directories and ratings: State Bar of Arizona Lawyer Directory, Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo, Google reviews.
- Verify licensing and discipline: check the State Bar of Arizona for any public records or disciplinary history.
- Look for experience specifically in car-accident and personal-injury cases (not just general practice). Trial experience is important if liability or damages are disputed.
- Track record: ask about comparable settlements/verdicts and whether the attorney handled those cases personally.
- Fee structure: most car-accident PI lawyers work on contingency (commonly around 33% to 40% plus costs). Confirm the percentage and who pays expert and court costs if you lose.
- Communication and accessibility: who will handle your calls/emails — the attorney or staff? How often will you get updates?
- Medical network and resources: does the firm have relationships with doctors, physical therapists, and medical lien arrangements to get you treated sooner?
- Local knowledge: a Phoenix lawyer familiar with local courts, adjusters, and judges can be an advantage.

Questions to ask at a free consult
- How long have you handled car-accident PI cases in Arizona?
- What percentage of your practice is car-accident/personal injury?
- Have you taken cases like mine to trial? What were the outcomes?
- What is your contingency fee and what costs are deducted from recovery?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day? How do you communicate?
- Can you provide client references or reviews?
- Any red flags or obstacles you see in my case?

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific dollar amount or outcome
- Requests for large upfront fees in a PI case
- Lack of clear answers about fees, timeline, or who will handle the case

If you want, I can:
- Help you draft a short message or script to contact attorneys
- Review names of specific Phoenix lawyers or firms you’ve found and help compare them
- Suggest how to prioritize firms to call based on your answers to the questions above

Tell me which direction you want to go (give me accident details, or share a few attorney names you’re considering), and I’ll help you next.
